title: Fallout 3 Teddy/Skeleton Reference Proximity Technical Gate
method: read-only export of placed references whose root BaseRecord is a teddy, skeleton or tracked gnome target
preserve source plugin, placed RefID, base FormID, cell/world, disabled/deleted/persistent flags and XYZ coordinates
for every teddy calculate nearest skeleton in the same location key
for every teddy calculate nearest tracked gnome in the same location key
bucket teddy-skeleton distances without converting proximity into narrative causality
emit exact candidate rows for manual scene review

distance_buckets.SAME_CELL: >512 game units but same cell/world location key
distance_buckets.NO_SKELETON_IN_LOCATION: no skeleton reference with same location key

admission_semantics.teddy_skeleton_recurrence: May be quantitatively supported by count and distance distribution.
admission_semantics.specific_scene_meaning: Requires manual scene/context binding; proximity alone cannot identify ownership, death cause or placer.
admission_semantics.single_in_world_placer: Cannot PASS from spatial recurrence alone.
admission_semantics.intentional_staging: Can be independently admitted for overt compositions such as tied bears/Help Us/gnome-camera, even before statistical scan.

mutation_and_false_inference_tests: same-cell but 2000-unit separation must not classify as TIGHT or NEAR
a gnome cannot count as a skeleton
a teddy cannot count as its own nearest object
different location keys must never be paired by XYZ coincidence
four or more close pairs do not create a single in-world placer claim
deleted/disabled references remain visible in receipt but must retain flags
